# Gus McClellan — Green Hyundai, Springfield, IL

> Gus McClellan is a car salesman at Green Hyundai in Springfield, Illinois. He has sold cars at Green Hyundai since 2013. He sells new Hyundais, used Hyundais, and used cars from other brands.

## Contact
- Call or text: (217) 671-2520
- Email: gus.mcclellan@greenfamilystores.net
- Dealership: Green Hyundai, 601 W. Stanford Ave., Springfield, IL 62704. Sales (217) 525-1370. Hours Mon-Fri 9am-7pm, Sat 9am-6pm, Sun closed.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/gus.mcclellan
- Website: https://gusatgreen.com/
